summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Alpha Architect International Quantitative Value ETF (IVAL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an active, equal-weighted portfolio of developed-market ex-US value stocks, screened for forensic accounting and earnings quality. IVAL was launched on Dec 17, 2014 and is issued by Alpha Architect.

holdings.infoBox: IVAL is an equity ETF with a total of 55 individual holdings. The top holdings are Repsol stock at 2.25%, Trend Micro at 2.22%, Sumitomo Heavy Industries at 2.15%, Toyo Tire at 2.14%, and Galp Energia, SGPS at 2.14%.
